LESSON: KUSOMA 5.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MSHIKAMANO WA KITAIFA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za 
Topic 5.2: Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha
2. kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa kuzingatia muundo
3. kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia ili kupata ujumbe

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa kuzingatia muundo
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa kuzingatia muundo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia ili kupata ujumbe
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia ili kupata ujumbe. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
4. Show that you can: kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha
2. kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa kuzingatia muundo
3. kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia ili kupata ujumbe

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
